@@U03506@@
Most honored and reverend ladies!
Permit me to draw near
to receive your triple blessing.
I approach you, a stranger, to be sure,
but unless ’m mistaken,
also a distant relative.
I have laid eyes on ancient gods before;
just yesterday 1 bowed my deepest
to 奥普斯 and 瑞亚.
The three Fates, sisters of 卡俄斯,
and yours as well, I saw yesterday—
or was it the day before?
But the likes of you I’ve never seen.
So delighted am I,
words fail me altogether.

@@U03508@@
He seems quite intelligent, this spirit.

@@U03510@@
What surprises me is no poet
has sung your praises.
Tell me, now, how is that possible?
When have I ever seen statues of you,
worthy ones? It’s you, ladies,
you that sculptors should sculpt.
Not 朱诺, 帕拉斯, 维纳斯, and the like.

@@U03512@@
Sunk in the depths of solitude and stillest night,
the thought has never crossed our mind.

@@U03514@@
No, and why should it?
Withdrawn here from the world,
seeing and seen by no one?
You must live where splendor and art sit
side by side on the same throne, where nimbly
translation:
@@U03506@@
最尊敬和尊敬的女士们！
请允许我靠近
接受您的三重祝福。
我确实接近你，一个陌生人，
但除非我弄错了，
也是一个远房亲戚。
我以前曾见过远古诸神；
就在昨天1我深深地鞠了一躬
前往奥普斯和瑞亚。
命运三女神，卡俄斯的姐妹，
还有你的，我昨天看到了——
或者是前一天？
但像你这样的人我从未见过。
我是如此高兴，
言语完全令我失望。

@@U03508@@
看来他还挺聪明的，这精神。

@@U03510@@
让我惊讶的是没有诗人
歌颂了你。
现在告诉我，这怎么可能？
我什么时候见过你的雕像
有价值的人？是你们，女士们，
雕塑家应该雕刻的你。
不是朱诺、帕拉斯、维纳斯之类的。

@@U03512@@
沉浸在孤独和寂静的夜的深处，
我们从来没有想到过这个想法。

@@U03514@@
不，为什么要这样做呢？
在这里与世隔绝，
看见又无人看见？
你必须生活在辉煌和艺术所在的地方
